title: Foundation shade match under a budget
prompt: Hi! I have a medium skin tone with an olive undertone. I'm looking for a fragrance-free foundation, and I don't want to pay $40 or more for it. I'd like to place the order today. Can you list every foundation shade in your store that works for me?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every shade that meets all of my conditions. If nothing matches, return an empty list.
why_hard: Six hard constraints must hold at the same time, and the valid set is defined by the price the customer would pay, not the list price. Near-misses sit right next to the valid answers: sold-out sibling shades, a shade at exactly $40.00, a new Aurevia launch that the promotion does not cover, and fragrance-free concealers in the same shade.
traps: Sold-out sibling shades of valid products (FDN-012-304O, FDN-015-303O)
Price exactly $40.00, which the customer excluded (FDN-013-301O)
Aurevia foundation at $48 that is valid only after the 20% promotion (FDN-016-302O, pays $38.40)
Aurevia new launch at $45 that the promotion does not cover (FDN-017-302O)
Medium olive concealers that are fragrance-free and under budget, but are not foundations
